var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var o = selector => String(J.select(selector).text()) ;
var og = selector => String(J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content'));
var book = {
	name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|小说|免费阅读|最新章节).*|[(（].*[）)]/g, ''),
	author: og('novel:author'),
	kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status').replace(/中|已/, ''),
	latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|章节目录|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/g, '') + ' • ' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-'),
	intro: '　　🔸最近更新：' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-') + '\n' + og('description').replace(/.*(观看小说|简介)[:：]|分享书籍.*|各位书友.*/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '\n'),
	cover: og('image'),
url:og('novel:read_url').replace('m.','www.'),
};
book;
</js>

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);
    }
  }
  return paramStr;
};

  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);

    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);

};

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);
    }
  }
  return paramStr;
};

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {

      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);

};

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);

      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);

};

let n=baseUrl.match(/read\/(\d+)/)
if(n){
let N=parseInt(n[1],10)
//java.log(N)

let b=java.ajax(`https://ixdzs8.com/novel/clist/,{"method":"post","body": "bid=${N}"}`)
//java.log(JSON.stringify(b))

let J=JSON.parse(b)
let M=J.data
//java.log(JSON.stringify(M))

let list=[]
Array.from(M).forEach(x=>{
	list.push({
	text:x.title,
	url:x.ctype == 1 ? '' : `https://ixdzs8.com/read/${N}/p${x.ordernum}.html`,

	volume:x.ctype
	})
	})

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list))
list

}
</js>

<js>
var nextChapterUrl = null; 
try {    
    var doc = result;
    if (!doc) {        
        throw new Error("HTML 解析失败"); 
    }        
    var nextLink = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(doc).select("a:containsOwn(下─章)");
    if (nextLink) {        
        var onclickValue = nextLink.attr("onclick");
        if (onclickValue) {                        
            var idRegex = /location\.href='([^']+)\.idx'/;
            var idMatch = onclickValue.match(idRegex);
            if (idMatch && idMatch[1]) {
                var chapterIdPart = idMatch[1];                 
                var checkRegex = /_\d+$/; 
                if (checkRegex.test(chapterIdPart)) {                                      
                    var newFileName = chapterIdPart + ".html";                                        
                    var lastSlashRegex = /\/[^/]*$/;
                    if (typeof baseUrl === 'string') {                        
                        nextChapterUrl = baseUrl.replace(lastSlashRegex, "/" + newFileName);
                        
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
} catch (e) {    
    nextChapterUrl = null; 
}
result = nextChapterUrl;
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var datax = null;
var allChapters = [];
var finalJsonOutput = null;
var inputString = baseUrl;
var parts = inputString.split(',');
var url = parts[0].trim();
try {
    var xDataRegex = /x-data="[^"]*Login\(\d+,\s*'([^']+)'/;
    var match = result.match(xDataRegex);
    if (match && match[1]) {
        datax = match[1];
    } else {
        java.log("未能从源码中匹配并提取到 x-data token");
        throw new Error("XSRF token not found"); // Token 是必须的
    }
    var urlWithXsrf = url + "?_xsrf=" + encodeURIComponent(datax);
    var cookie = "85_ID=" + java.getCookie(url, "85_ID");
    var baseHeaders = {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; 2312DRAABC) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/132.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36",
        "Content-Type": "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
        "Referer": url,
        "Accept": "application/json, text/plain",
        "Cookie": cookie
    };
    var slices = [];
    var selectContentRegex = /<select class="[^"]*select-primary[^"]*"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/select>/;
    var selectMatch = result.match(selectContentRegex);
    if (selectMatch && selectMatch[1]) {
        var optionsHtml = selectMatch[1];
        var sliceRegex = /(\d+)\s*~\s*(\d+)/g;
        var sliceMatch;
        while ((sliceMatch = sliceRegex.exec(optionsHtml)) !== null) {
            var start = parseInt(sliceMatch[1], 10);
            var end = parseInt(sliceMatch[2], 10);
            if (!isNaN(start) && !isNaN(end)) {
                slices.push([start, end]);
            }
        }
    }
    if (slices.length === 0) {
        java.log("未能提取到任何章节 Slice，将尝试获取默认范围 [1, 200]");
        slices = [
            [1, 200]
        ];
    }
    java.log("将要处理的 Slices: " + JSON.stringify(slices));
    for (var i = 0; i < slices.length; i++) {
        var currentSlice = slices[i];
        // java.log("准备获取 Slice: " + currentSlice.join(' ~ '));
        var maxAttempts = 3;
        var success = false;
        for (var attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
            java.log("尝试获取 Slice " + currentSlice.join('~') + " (第 " + attempt + "/" + maxAttempts + " 次)");
            var jsonString = null;
            try {
                var bodyPayload = {
                    "action": "chapters",
                    "slice": currentSlice
                };
                var op = {
                    "body": JSON.stringify(bodyPayload),
                    "method": "post",
                    "headers": baseHeaders
                };
                var requestString = urlWithXsrf + "," + JSON.stringify(op);
                jsonString = java.ajax(requestString);
                if (jsonString && (jsonString.trim().startsWith('{') || jsonString.trim().startsWith('['))) {
                    var jsonObject = JSON.parse(jsonString);
                    if (jsonObject && jsonObject.result && Array.isArray(jsonObject.result.chapters)) {
                        var fetchedCount = jsonObject.result.chapters.length;
                        allChapters = allChapters.concat(jsonObject.result.chapters);
                        // java.log("成功获取 Slice " + currentSlice.join('~') + " (第 " + attempt + " 次尝试): 本次获取 " + fetchedCount + " 章, 累计 " + allChapters.length + " 章");
                        java.log("成功获取 Slice " + currentSlice.join('~') + " (第 " + attempt + " 次尝试)");
                        success = true;
                        break;
                    } else {
                        java.log("第 " + attempt + " 次尝试: Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " 的 JSON 响应格式不正确或未包含 chapters 数组: " + jsonString.substring(0, 200));
                    }
                } else {
                    java.log("第 " + attempt + " 次尝试: Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " 返回的不是有效的 JSON: " + jsonString.substring(0, 200));
                    java.log("Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " Raw Response (Attempt " + attempt + "): " + jsonString);
                }
            } catch (ajaxOrParseError) {
                java.log("第 " + attempt + " 次尝试获取或解析 Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " 时出错: " + ajaxOrParseError);
            }
            if (!success && attempt < maxAttempts) {
                var retryDelay = 4000;
                java.log("等待 " + retryDelay + "ms 后重试...");

                Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(retryDelay);
            } else if (!success && attempt === maxAttempts) {

                java.log("已达到最大尝试次数 (" + maxAttempts + ")，放弃获取 Slice 重新搜索过下cf试试" + currentSlice.join('~'));
            }
        }
        if (i < slices.length - 1) {
            java.log("等待2500ms");
            Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(2500);
        }
    }
    var combinedResult = {
        "code": 0,
        "result": {
            "code": 1,
            "chapters": allChapters
        }
    };
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify(combinedResult);

} catch (e) {
    java.log("处理目录 JS 规则时发生顶层错误: " + e);
    finalJsonOutput = null;
}
result = finalJsonOutput; 
</js>

(function(){
    // 使用正则检测分页标签
    const hasNextLink = /<a\s+rel=\"next\"\s+class=\"next\"[^>]*>下—页<\/a>/i.test(result);
    if (!hasNextLink) return '';
    
    try {
        // 动态生成分页URL（适配数字型URL）
        let url = baseUrl;
        const pageMatch = url.match(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/);
        if (!pageMatch) return '';
        
        const [_, baseId, currentPage] = pageMatch;
        const pageNum = currentPage ? parseInt(currentPage) : 1;
        
        // 安全限制（最大3页）
        if (pageNum > 2) return ''; // 第3页后停止
        
        // 生成新URL（如 /123_2.html → /123_3.html）
        return url.replace(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/, `${baseId}_${pageNum + 1}.html`);
    } catch(e) {
        return '';
    }
})()
</js>

if (charset == '')
{
    charset = String(doc.select('head>meta[content~=charset=]').attr('content')).replace(/^.*charset=([a-z0-9\-]+).*$/i, 
    '$1');
}
//java.log(method);
//java.log(action);

for (var it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.attr('value');
    if (k == sk) {
        //body+=sk+'={{java.encodeURI(key,\''+ charset+'\');}}&';
        body += sk + '={{key}}&';
    }
    else {
        body += k + '=' + v + '&';
    }
}
es = form.select('select[name]');
for (it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.select('option')[0].attr('value');
    body += k + '=' + v + '&';
}
body = String(body).replace(/&$/, '');
java.log(body);
if (method.match(/post/i))

.replace(/^(\d+)[、．]第.+章/,'第$1章')
.replace(/^(\d+)、\d+、/,'第$1章 ')
.replace(/^(\d+)、\d+/,'第$1章')
.replace(/^(第.+章)\s?\d+/,'$1')
.replace(/^(\d+)、/,'第$1章 ')
.replace(/^(第.+章)\s?第.+章/,'$1')
.replace(/第\s(.+)\s章/,'第$1章')
.replace(/.*(chapter|Chapter)\s?(\d+)\s?/,'$1 $2 ')
.replace(/\(.+\)/,'')
.replace(/\[|。/,'')
.replace(/第([零一二两三四五六七八九十百千]+)章/g,java.toNumChapter(result))

<js>
  function login() {
  	 const user = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号"))
    const pw = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("密码"))
    let sign = java.md5Encode(`isDevice=Android&password=${pw}&phone=${user}&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    let data = JSON.stringify({
      isDevice: "Android",
      password: pw,
      phone: user,
      regDevice: "2",
      sign: sign
    })
    let op = JSON.stringify({
      method: "POST",
      body: data
    })
    let res = java.ajax(`https://api.shaoniandream.com/Login/login,${op}`)
    let $ = JSON.parse(res)
    if($.status != 1) java.toast($.msg)
    java.put("uid",$.data.id)
    source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify({
      logintoken: $.data.logintoken
    }))
  	}
</js>

  let $ = JSON.parse(result)
  let uid = java.get("uid") != "undefined" ? java.get("uid") : "-1"
  let array = []
  $.data.chapterList.forEach((booklet) => {
    array.push({
    	 name: booklet.title,
    	 isv: true
    })
    booklet.chapterList.forEach((chapter) => {
    	 let sign = java.md5Encode(`BookID=${$.data.id}&UserID=${uid}&chapter_id=${chapter.id}&isDevice=Android&isMarket=true&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    	 let data = JSON.stringify({
    	   BookID: $.data.id,
    	   UserID: uid,
    	   chapter_id: chapter.id,
    	   isDevice: "Android",
    	   isMarket:"true",
    	   regDevice: "2",
    	   sign: sign
    	 })
      let op = JSON.stringify({
        method: "POST",
        body: data
      })
      array.push({
        name: chapter.title,
        url: "https://api.shaoniandream.com/Booklibrary/readchapter," + op,
        time: java.timeFormat(chapter.release_time_now * 1000),
        vip: chapter.isFree == 1,
        buy: chapter.lock == 1
      })
    })
  })
  array
</js>

var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

累了，请您进来歇歇！让我们一同潜入五百米深蓝：
挖一挖，随心律动的声音；
听一听，不期而遇的音乐；
品一品，灵魂挥洒的文字；
说一说，简单质朴的轶事。
在这里，愿您洗褪铅华，笑对本真！暂时远离现实的浮躁，暂时忘记生活的压力，少一丝烦恼的羁绊，多一些宁静的愉悦。
在这里，请您放慢脚步，收拾心情！因为，挖沙是属于您的纯净角落。
by墨殇
